Member.description: A company member: actor, crew or creative. A first name alone is not an identity.

Show.description: A production in the season, named by its title, independent of its cast.

Casting.description:
Who holds which part on a show: its lead, the lead's understudy, or its director.
An understudy does not play the lead unless called on.

Coaching.description: A standing service one member gives another: voice coaching, or dressing them backstage.

Rehearsal.description: A rehearsal session for a scene. called_by scheduled it, led_by ran the room, noted_by took the notes.

Costume.description: A garment for a show. fitting says pending, fitted or altered; rented stays empty until its source is known.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Show)-[:director]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.show_title = 'Night Ferry' RETURN n1.stage_name AS stage_name

questions.q: Which shows are directed by me?
questions.speaker: ingrid
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:directed]->(n1:Show) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.show_title AS show_title

questions.speaker: quilla
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:voice_coach]->(n1:Member) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.stage_name AS stage_name
MATCH (n0:Member)-[:pupil]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.stage_name = 'Kamala Iyer' RETURN n1.stage_name AS stage_name

questions.q: Was everyone off book for the act one run?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.scene = 'act one run' RETURN n0.off_book AS off_book

questions.q: Is there a record that the velvet cloak was rented?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Costume) WHERE n0.garment = 'velvet cloak' RETURN coalesce(n0.rented, false) AS rented

questions.q: Which rehearsals did Parisa Moradi lead?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:led_by]-(n1:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.stage_name = 'Parisa Moradi' RETURN n1.scene AS scene

questions.q: Who took notes at the tech rehearsal?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal)-[:noted_by]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.scene = 'tech rehearsal' RETURN n1.stage_name AS stage_name

questions.q: How many hours did act two blocking take?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.scene = 'Act two blocking' RETURN n0.hours AS hours
MATCH (n0:Member)-[:dresser]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.stage_name = 'Rafael Antunes' RETURN n1.stage_name AS stage_name

questions.q: What did the velvet cloak cost?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Costume) WHERE n0.garment = 'velvet cloak' RETURN n0.cost_euros AS cost_euros

questions.q: Which garments are for Night Ferry?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Show)<-[:show]-(n1:Costume) WHERE n0.show_title = 'Night Ferry' RETURN n1.garment AS garment

questions.speaker: rafael
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:called_by]-(n1:Rehearsal) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.scene AS scene
MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.scene CONTAINS 'run' RETURN n0.scene AS scene

questions.q: What is the garment and fitting of every costume?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Costume) RETURN n0.garment AS garment, n0.fitting AS fitting

questions.q: Who plays the lead in Salt Harbour?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Show)-[:lead]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.show_title = 'Salt Harbour' RETURN n1.stage_name AS stage_name

questions.q: Where was the act two blocking held?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.scene = 'Act two blocking' RETURN n0.room AS room
